camel_example: aliyun iot CopyThingModel --region cn-hangzhou --TargetProductKey a1BwwG00000 --SourceProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_en: Copies the Thing Specification Language model of a specified product to a destination product
description_zh: 调用该接口复制指定产品的物模型到目标产品
kebab_example: aliyun iot copy-thing-model --source-product-key a1BwAGV0000 --target-product-key a1BwwG00000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyThingModel

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If the ID is available, specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The ResourceGroupId request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the Thing Specification Language model to copy belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh:
要复制的物模型所属产品的ProductKey。
可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看ProductKey的取值
parameters.name: source_product_key

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the destination product.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh:
目标产品的ProductKey。
可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看**ProductKey**的取值
parameters.name: target_product_key

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the Thing Specification Language model to copy.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html operation to view the version number of the source Thing Specification Language model
parameters.help_zh:
要复制的物模型版本号。
可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html，查看源物模型的版本号
parameters.name: source_model_version
